synthesis.body: One obligation lives in up to five places: the acceptance criterion, its verification group, and the plan's Tests, Approach and stub-disposition Constraint. Applying a sustained finding only to the surface it cites produced two confirmed regressions in a single round — a task whose test bullets required descriptor-anchored traversal while its pinned stub Constraint still said 'canonicalise before opening', and an absent-input case removed from a criterion but left in the plan's pinned lifecycle test. new-spec's spec-authoring-rubric.md names this class exactly under 'Find the property's siblings', but work-loop's FIX step compresses it to 'fix the established defect, not the symptom' and routes nowhere. An agent applying findings from FIX rather than through new-spec step 7 therefore has the idea without the checklist or the mechanical check. After every repair, enumerate the obligation's other homes before closing the finding.

title: Repairing the surface a finding cites leaves its sibling surfaces contradicting it
